headline: Godcrofts Erupts as Dead Lands Resume the Storm
war_summary: Since our last edition the torch has passed to Godcrofts: five base actions inside two hours, twelve alone at Lipsia across the day, make it the busiest sheet on the map, though its casualty rolls stay light. The Dead Lands have resumed their storm after the afternoon lull, three actions in two hours about The Salt March, their day's ledger of some twelve thousand six hundred Colonial and fifteen thousand Warden losses second only to the Weathered Expanse, silent in its works yet bleeding at nine hundred Colonial and seven hundred Warden losses an hour. Farranac Coast keeps pace with three late actions around Mara, Scythe and Terra. Fisherman's Row, lively at the previous filing, has gone quiet since its evening work at Fort Ember, and Lykos Isle files no base movement since mid-afternoon even as its casualty returns accelerate sharply. Stlican Shelf logs fresh Warden losses rising in Fort Hoarfrost's account, while Loch Mor, Marban Hollow and Kings Cage cool from earlier violence. The Colonials hold some two hundred thirty strategic works to the Wardens' one hundred eighty-odd, with one base lying demolished at Godcrofts. This is the hundred-and-fourth day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.
